title: Kubo linear-response commutator (frequency-domain analyticity not declared)
expression_sketch: Time-domain Kubo (Wikipedia, general formula): <A(t)> = <A>_0 - (I/hbar)*Integral(<[A(t), V(t')]>_0, (t', t0, t)); H(t) = H0 + V(t)*Heaviside(t - t0); equilibrium trace uses rho_0 = exp(-beta*H0), beta = 1/k_B T. Desired but not on this page: retarded chi(omega + i0+) or a half-plane analyticity statement.
latent_structure: Causal commutator kernel in time. A representation-discovery target in this line would be the retarded frequency kernel / spectral representation / i0+ boundary value of that commutator. Those analytic-domain hypotheses are not written on the cited Kubo page.

beta.notes: beta = 1/k_B T as written in the equilibrium trace; T>0 not inserted

function_domains.A: observable whose equilibrium expectation is Tr[rho_0 A]/Z_0
function_domains.V: hermitian perturbation defined for all t

positivity_conditions.statement: The perturbation is switched on after t0 via Heaviside theta(t - t0)
positivity_conditions.label: DECLARED
positivity_conditions.source: Wikipedia Kubo formula: H(t) = H0 + V(t) theta(t - t0)

analytic_domains.statement: Retarded frequency-domain response analytic in Im omega > 0
analytic_domains.label: NOT_DECLARED
analytic_domains.source: Wikipedia Kubo formula (general Kubo formula section) does not state a half-plane analyticity condition on chi(omega)

analytic_domains.statement: i0+ (or omega + i eta, eta -> 0+) prescription for the Fourier transform of the causal commutator
analytic_domains.label: NOT_DECLARED
analytic_domains.source: Wikipedia Kubo formula general formula remains an integral over t' in [t0, t]; no Sokhotski/i0+ identity is declared there

limit_domains.statement: Fourier transform of the causal commutator to a retarded chi(omega)
limit_domains.label: NOT_DECLARED
limit_domains.source: Not stated in the Wikipedia general Kubo formula section used as the source

source_provenance: Kubo, R., Statistical-Mechanical Theory of Irreversible Processes. I, J. Phys. Soc. Jpn. 12, 570-586 (1957), doi:10.1143/JPSJ.12.570

public_source: Wikipedia, Kubo formula, General Kubo formula (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kubo_formula); Kubo, J. Phys. Soc. Jpn. 12, 570 (1957), doi:10.1143/JPSJ.12.570.
why_not_cse_lgg: Even as a time-domain identity the structure is a causal commutator kernel, not CSE. The case is recorded because a verifier for a retarded frequency representation would need analytic-domain data the source does not declare.
proposer_leak_risk: Do not plant sealed-control gold names. Do not insert i0+, eta>0, or T>0 to rescue the frequency-domain reading of this page.
notes: Rejected as PROBLEM_UNDERSPECIFIED for the frequency-domain representation task: analytic-domain predicates a verifier needs are NOT_DECLARED. Time-domain causality and the equilibrium beta-trace ARE declared and must not be confused with i0+. T>0 is not inserted. Not the sealed G3 control. Do not backfill from Mahan/AGD.
